deadline.value: No upcoming closing date is published: the Winter Call 2026/27 closed on 18 October 2026, and the Summer Call 2027 opens in March 2027 with no closing date yet.

gre_subject.value: No GRE subject test is mentioned.

supervisor.value: Fellowship candidates are admitted by a selection committee and choose a thesis group after rotations; applying directly to a group leader is the other route.
supervisor.quote: The special feature of the fellowships is that they are independent and neither tied to a research group nor to a project

funding.value: Fellowships are competitive, with up to 10 awarded per year, and give full funding for the whole PhD.
funding.quote: the Biozentrum PhD Fellowships are awarded on a competitive basis to a maximum of 10 successful candidates per year

also.quote: The fellowship provides full funding for the entire PhD

entry_route.value: Applicants need an MSc or equivalent; in exceptional cases a four-year bachelor's degree can be accepted.
entry_route.quote: You must hold or expect to soon receive a university degree that qualifies you for a PhD program at the University of Basel (MSc or equivalent)

also.quote: In exceptional cases, outstanding students with a 4 year Bachelor's degree, typically from outside the Bologna System, are also eligible to apply

notes: Covers the Biozentrum International PhD Program, which takes biology as its main field. The Winter Call 2026/27 closed 18 Oct 2026; no upcoming date is quoted. Direct applications to the 31 research groups have group-specific deadlines that are not published on the page checked.
